name: Norbert Preining
description:
Norbert Preining, an Austrian native, stands at the crossroads of diverse disciplines as a Researcher, Developer, and Open Source Enthusiast, with a profound passion for mountain guiding. Based in both Vienna, Austria and Ishikawa, Japan, his professional journey spans multiple domains, including machine learning, big data, data analytics, and software development, underpinned by a solid foundation in many-valued logics, proof theory, intuitionistic logic, and mathematics. His expertise extends into the realms of algebraic specification and CafeOBJ, showcasing a remarkable blend of theoretical insight and practical application.
Currently, Norbert serves as a Principal Software Engineer at arXiv, contributing to the forefront of academic publishing and scientific communication. Prior to this, he honed his skills as a Senior Machine Learning Engineer at Mercari, Inc., where he tackled complex challenges in the e-commerce space with innovative AI solutions.
